subject: Order Form: clarify inspection scope, evidence cadence, and MSA redlines
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@helixhealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: HelixHealth Security <security@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form — clarification on inspection scope and evidence cadence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the demo last week — the technical team liked the latency numbers. Before legal signs the Order Form we need to clarify a few items on the security exhibit / audit rights so we can brief procurement and infosec. The main asks from Helix:

- Pen test window: what notice do you need, and do you support scoped/limited testing against staging only?
- Evidence cadence: we need weekly export snapshots (for a 12-week onboarding) + quarterly SOC2 artifact handback; can you confirm what you can deliver and the format?
- Access model: will Redwood provide a staging account with ephemeral credentials and scoped RBAC?
- MSA redline boundaries: we want the Order Form to include an explicit clause limiting inspections to non-prod environments and prohibiting access to customer PII.

I've attached our questionnaire (Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) that includes standard requests. Please loop in your legal and product/security folks; we want to close contract redlines this month so engineering can schedule a pen test.

Can you confirm a proposed cadence and any redline language you expect?

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Head of Security
HelixHealth
attachments: Helix_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@helixhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — clarification on inspection scope and evidence cadence

Nora — thanks for the clear list. Putting a short plan below so legal/product know what to expect.

Summary proposal (quick):
- Inspection scope: Staging-only, ephemeral accounts. Redwood will agree to a "scoped inspection" carveout in the Order Form that limits penetration testing and inspections to designated staging clusters and services, explicitly excluding customer PII stores and production backups.
- Pen test timing: we request a 14-day advance window with a 48-hour notice prior to active exploitation; agreed live-testing window limited to 2 business days unless otherwise approved.
- Evidence cadence: during onboarding we'll provide weekly snapshot exports for 12 weeks (CSV + sanitized logs), and a consolidated SOC2 artifact package quarterly (PDF/CSV). We'll also provide a short evidence mapping sheet (attached) that maps Helix's questionnaire items to where artifacts live.
- Access model: Redwood can provision a scoped staging tenant (ephemeral creds, RBAC) and rotate credentials after the test. We will require the tester to sign our standard NDA and a scoped Rules of Engagement doc.

Action items / next steps:
1) Legal: propose redline language for the Order Form + MSA exhibit (Karthik / Priyom, can you take the first cut?).
2) Product/SRE: confirm staging cluster availability and approximate dates for creating an isolated tenant (Marissa/Laura).
3) Nexus: Mateo will coordinate timeline with Helix once legal flags are reconciled.

Proposed timeline: legal redline by Tue 19 May, staging tenant ready by Thu 27 May, pen-test scheduled week of 31 May. Is that feasible from Helix's side?

I'll attach the evidence mapping sheet to help speed approvals.

— Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: evidence_mapping_sheet.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — legal redlines and proposed MSA language

Team — putting a first-pass redline summary below and attaching the redline PDF (redline_msa_v1.pdf). Highlights and rationale:

1) Bounded inspection clause (new):
- Language: "Customer inspection and penetration testing is limited to non-production environments expressly designated in the Order Form. Redwood will not provide access to production systems, backups, or PII stores. Any activities that could impact production availability or data integrity are prohibited."
- Rationale: protects availability and sensitive data; mirrors precedent clauses we've used with other healthcare customers.

2) Rules of Engagement & tester obligations:
- Require tester to sign NDA and Rules of Engagement; tester must supply a written test plan 72 hours before active testing and name an on-call contact.

3) Evidence delivery cadence (Order Form exhibit):
- Include explicit deliverables: weekly onboarding exports for 12 weeks (sanitized CSV + log snapshots), quarterly SOC2 artifact package (signed PDF), and a one-time pen-test attestation summary from the third party.

4) Data & retention carveouts:
- Redwood will provide redacted artifacts where required; Redwood will not be obligated to deliver raw backups or customer PII. Specify retention window and redaction standard.

5) Timing/notice and limitation of scope:
- Propose 14 days advance scheduling and limit active testing to up to 2 business days (exceptions require written consent).

6) DocuSign / execution flow:
- We'll prepare the Order Form + redline MSA and send via DocuSign for Helix signature. Recommend standard counter-sign process in HubSpot so CS can track acceptance.

Please review the attached redline_msa_v1.pdf and flag any items that require escalation (insurance, indemnity language). I'll be available for a brief call with Helix legal if needed.

— Priyom
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_msa_v1.pdf

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with Helix's expectations. A few clarifications and confirmations:

- We accept the bounded inspection clause as drafted, provided the final language includes an explicit exclusion for production backups and live PII stores.
- Helix will have our pen-test vendor sign the NDA and Rules of Engagement; we can provide the vendor's test plan 72 hours before testing.
- Evidence cadence: the weekly snapshots and quarterly SOC2 artifact package are approved. For the onboarding exports, Helix prefers CSV + minimal contextual metadata; the evidence_mapping_sheet was useful.
- Staging tenant: Helix requests that the isolated staging tenant be created and accessible by 27 May (UTC). Please confirm by EOD Thu 21 May.
- Execution: Helix legal prefers DocuSign execution for the Order Form and the MSA amendment. Please send when the redline PDF is ready.

Next steps & owners:
- Mateo: confirm DocuSign link and send Order Form by Thu 21 May.
- Priyom / Karthik: finalize redline PDF and include explicit exclusion language re: backups/PII.
- Marissa / Laura: confirm staging tenant availability by 21 May (internal).

If all of the above looks good we'll schedule the pen-test for the week of 31 May and share the tester contact.

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Head of Security, HelixHealth
